direction_definition: Mean complete-response correction gradient over three original training phrases. Fresh unclipped Adam proposal -g/(abs(g)+eps),then unit-normalize each paired neuron across its incoming rows and outgoing column. This is a fixed direction family, not a simulated multi-step Adam fit. Apply selected directions at both frozen scales.
selection: Same per-layer neuron counts as the matched rank-one budget. Algorithmic candidates are the top64 original correction-gradient neurons per layer. Seed11 random supports are also captured but cannot affect risk-score damping or algorithmic selection. Compare norm-only,gain-only,gain/risk and random supports using identical proposals.
risk: Two independent locally seeded Rademacher softmax-covariance VJPs per original preservation response. Normalize by sqrt(response tokens),then equally across probes. Center at the frozen base; no gradient of zero reference KL is used. Rank individual gains squared over estimated curvature plus mean-curvature damping. Joint selected-support predictions sum probe dots before squaring.
contexts: Teacher contexts use the original canonical references,including EOS. These are fixed conditional-token distributions,not a full sequence-distribution Fisher estimate. Only the six preservation-training contexts influence scoring. Exposed scope/utility questions are held out of selection;their known outputs do not choose scale or support.
success: At scale0.03,in both development cases,gain_risk must reduce heldout mean anchored KL by at least20% versus adam_gain while retaining at least half its positive actual correction-NLL improvement,and itself improve correction NLL by at least0.001. It must also improve correction_gain_squared/heldout_KL by at least25%,with baseline heldout_KL>=1e-8 required for an informative comparison. At scale0.01,report joint predicted/actual calibration KL for every condition; a ratio outside[0.25,4] where actual KL>=1e-8 fails local numerical calibration. Require at least one informative small-scale condition in each case. Even success only licenses a trained-method pilot with LoRA,not a superiority claim.
limits: Two exposed facts,one small calibration bank,two sketches per anchor,shortlisted neurons and fixed initial directions. Sparse-group scores ignore between-group interactions during ranking;the joint estimate exposes those interactions. No multi-step optimizer is run;data-informed one-step edits are tested and restored. No robust fitted recipe is claimed,and no fresh cases are used. Record all conditions,quantization differences,unrelated answers and discovery cost.
